description: This file implements the TimeZoneInfo class for handling time zone data using the IANA Time Zone Database, including parsing zoneinfo files, managing transitions, and converting between civil and absolute times.

classes.name: TimeZoneInfo
classes.description: Main class managing time zone data, transitions, and conversions.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Helper class for parsing zoneinfo file headers.

classes.name: ZoneInfoSource
classes.description: Abstract interface for zoneinfo data sources.

classes.name: FileZoneInfoSource
classes.description: Implementation of ZoneInfoSource using stdio FILE*.

classes.name: AndroidZoneInfoSource
classes.description: Zone info source for Android-specific zoneinfo files.

classes.name: FuchsiaZoneInfoSource
classes.description: Zone info source for Fuchsia components.

methods.name: ResetToBuiltinUTC
methods.description: Resets the TimeZoneInfo to a fixed UTC offset zone.

methods.name: Header::Build
methods.description: Builds header info from raw zoneinfo header bytes.

methods.name: Header::DataLength
methods.description: Calculates data length based on time size (4 or 8 bytes).

methods.name: EquivTransitions
methods.description: Checks if two transition types are equivalent.

methods.name: GetTransitionType
methods.description: Finds or creates a transition type with specified attributes.

methods.name: ExtendTransitions
methods.description: Extends transition data using POSIX spec for future years.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads zoneinfo data from a source, parsing headers and transitions.

methods.name: LocalTime
methods.description: Converts unix time to civil time with a specific transition type or transition.

methods.name: TimeLocal
methods.description: Converts civil time to absolute time, with optional 400-year shift.

methods.name: BreakTime
methods.description: Converts absolute time to civil time, considering transitions.

methods.name: NextTransition
methods.description: Finds the next transition after a given time.

methods.name: PrevTransition
methods.description: Finds the previous transition before a given time.
